item.title: NVIDIA's $5,000 AI box is the "cheap" one — and that's the whole story
item.description: NVIDIA launched a cheaper DGX Spark for local AI at $4,999 — more than the 128GB original's $3,999 debut. The pricing tells you everything about where AI hardware stands in late 2026: memory is the bottleneck, and local AI has a price tag to prove it.

item.title: Apple just told AI agents to stop asking for your whole hard drive
item.description: Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access explicitly because of AI agents — and it's the clearest signal yet that "just trust the agent" was never a permission model.

item.title: 6 desk upgrades for people who work with AI all day
item.description: Six desk upgrades actually worth buying on Amazon AU right now — real prices, in stock, for people who spend their days working with AI.

item.title: OpenAI's Dots — the AI that keeps working after you close the tab
item.description: OpenAI's Dots are agents that live inside ChatGPT and keep working after you close the tab. Here's what they do, what they cost, and the safety story OpenAI didn't want to tell.
